description: Australia HECS-HELP maximum student contribution amounts per Equivalent Full-Time Student Load (EFTSL) by discipline band, 1989-2026. From 1989-1996 a flat rate applied; three-band structure introduced in 1997. Job-Ready Graduates Package restructured to four bands from 2021. Sources: Department of Education (Study Assist), Higher Education Support Act 2003 schedules, legislation.gov.au.
note: Amounts are maximum student contribution per 1.0 EFTSL (one full year of full-time study). Universities may charge less. National Priorities band (nursing, education, maths/science) existed 2005-2009, reducing amounts for those disciplines — not shown separately here (NP band was lower than Band 2). Job-Ready Graduates Package from 2021 restructured disciplines: Band 1 (law/commerce), Band 2 (maths/science/IT/agriculture), Band 3 (humanities/communications/social science), Band 4 (medicine/dentistry/vet science). Pre-2021 band structure was different: Band 1=humanities/education, Band 2=computing/science/engineering/health, Band 3=law/accounting/medicine. Direct comparisons across 2020-2021 boundary require caution.

1989.note: Single flat HECS rate introduced: $1,800 per year (all disciplines)

2005.note: National Priorities band added for nursing/education: ~$3,874

2014.note: Significant increase from 2014 under Higher Education Reform proposals (some deregulation); note actual enacted increase.

2021.note: Job-Ready Graduates Package restructure: new Band 1=law/commerce/economics (HIGH), Band 2=maths/science/IT/agriculture, Band 3=humanities/comms/social science (REDUCED), Band 4=medicine/dentistry/vet

2024.note: Band structure confirmed: Band 1=law/accounting/commerce, Band 2=science/computing/engineering, Band 3=humanities/education/nursing, Band 4=medicine/dentistry/vet

preTo2021.band1: Humanities, behavioural science, social studies, education, nursing, foreign languages, visual and performing arts
preTo2021.band2: Mathematics, statistics, computing, built environment, health, engineering, science, surveying, agriculture
preTo2021.band3: Law, accounting, commerce, economics, administration, dentistry, medicine, veterinary science

from2021.band1: Law, accounting, commerce, economics, administration (high-income professions)
from2021.band2: Mathematics, science, statistics, computing, IT, engineering, surveying, agriculture, environmental science
from2021.band3: Humanities, communications, social studies, education, nursing, visual arts (subsidised to encourage domestic demand)

keyTrend: Band 1 (humanities/education) rose from $3,330 in 1997 to $6,566 in 2020, then was cut to $3,950 in 2021 under the Job-Ready Graduates Package. Law/commerce (Band 3 pre-2021, Band 1 post-2021) rose from $5,500 to $17,399.
